evidence_quote: Together, these findings highlight the gut–bone axis as a central framework linking microbiota-derived IPA to skeletal remodeling and provide preclinical proof-of-concept for an engineered C. sporogenes–IPA strategy with therapeutic potential in PMOP.
rationale: The study focuses on microbiota-derived IPA and an engineered bacterial therapy for postmenopausal osteoporosis and bone remodeling. It does not address cardiovascular disease, cardiovascular risk, or therapies targeting cardiovascular outcomes.
